name: zlib
notes: The recipe undefines _WIN32/_WIN32_WCE/__WIN32__/WIN32/_MSC_VER so zlib stays on its generic POSIX path when the Windows CRT wrapper uses a Windows LLVM target.
RANLIB is set to true because the optional zlib ranlib step is redundant for the LLVM archive path and currently exposes a Windows mksh subshell status quirk.
Windows CRT-shell builds currently run make serially and pass SHELL=/system/bin/mksh so recipe commands use the project shell/process path.
